Andhra Pradesh Local Body Elections Marked by Nomination Violence

Local body elections in Andhra Pradesh saw violence during the nomination process, with the opposition alleging that its candidates were prevented from filing nominations. Chandrababu Naidu accused the YSRCP of fomenting violence. The Andhra Pradesh Election Commissioner stated that complaints are being examined and called for fair and peaceful polls. Polling has begun for 100 urban local bodies.
